about: A harder test set for the matching engine, used only by matching/tune.js --hard. It is never seeded. In every group the owner and the finder describe the same item in different words, the way real reports do, and most groups add a look-alike found item (same category, colour and area) that is a different thing. Spots and times work as in seed-pairs.json.
